notes.title: Minor update released. Build 0.4.7.
notes.content:
[i]minor development update[/i] // [b]changelog for build 0.4.7.[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed UI not scaling properly when playing on Steam Deck. 
[*] Code cleanup and optimization.
[*] Added an auto-tooltip widget at the player initial input screen when the game is running on Steam Deck. This should prevent players from getting stuck at that screen.
[*] Adjusted game options that are available to the player from within the main menu in order to resolve a bug with settings not properly translating into the game.
[*] Fixed an issue with the visual appearance of the BOOT CAMP button on the main menu that caused players to believe their mouse cursor was stuck.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck UI fix coming soon
notes.content:
Hey everyone, first off [b]THANK YOU[/b] for an incredible launch. This game was immensely fun to design/develop and my hope is you are all enjoying wrecking destruction upon your enemies in search of those missing nuclear launch codes.

[h1]QUICK DEVELOPMENT UPDATE:[/h1] I am aware of UI scaling issues when playing the game on Steam Deck. An update to fix this will be released soon.

Please jump over to the Community page and post on the discussion board if you have any further feedback or notice any other quirky issues lingering in the wild.

- Avery
[url=http://EnterTheWolf.com]Gray Wolf Interactive[/url]

notes.title: Extraction Force is releasing today!
notes.content:
[h1]LETTER FROM THE DEVELOPER[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42940770/ec7ee7986394e7c0e936672b84a28ca8f2997733.jpg[/img]
[h2]Good morning world![/h2] Extraction Force started out as a small summer project. Just a simple game idea that would take several months to prototype, polish and ship. Well... here we are, two years of on-again-off-again development later (typical indie-dev life stuff!) and I am extremely excited to finally announce...

[h2][u]Extraction Force releases today - March 21st, 2024![/u][/h2]

[h3][b]WISHLIST TO ENLIST![/b]
Pickup your copy today and prepare for battle.[/h3]

Thank you for allowing me to share my creative endeavors with you. I hope you enjoy playing Extraction Force as much as I enjoyed designing and developing it!

- [i]Avery[/i]
[b]Gray Wolf Interactive[/b]
http://EnterTheWolf.com

notes.title: THANK YOU FOR PLAYING THE EXTRACTION FORCE DEMO!
notes.content: [b]Thank you so much[/b] to everyone who has taken the time to download and play the Extraction Force demo during Steam Next Fest! This morning a small patch was released for the demo. It implements minor design tweaks to the third island, several bug fixes, and the code for the radio system has been revamped to fix the occasional overlapping issue. Please add Extraction Force to your Wishlist if you enjoyed the demo, and feel free to head over to the Community Hub and post any feedback or comments you have on the discussion board.
